variants.name: AccBiO algorithm rule with explicit subsolvers
public_inputs: lambda=4/(sqrt(Ly)+sqrt(mu_y))²; theta=max{(1-sqrt(lambda mu_y))²,(1-sqrt(lambda Ly))²}; positive supplied N,M; source complexity-specific N,M are not expanded here.
variants.query_and_update: For t=1..N: y^t=s^{t-1}-grad_y g(xk,s^{t-1})/Ly; s^t=[2sqrt(kappa_y)/(sqrt(kappa_y)+1)]y^t-[(sqrt(kappa_y)-1)/(sqrt(kappa_y)+1)]y^{t-1}. Set H=g_yy(xk,y^N),b=grad_y f(xk,y^N),v0=v1=0. For t=1..M-1 compute v^{t+1}=v^t-lambda(Hv^t-b)+theta(v^t-v^{t-1}). Gk=grad_x f(xk,y^N)-g_xy(xk,y^N)v^M. z_{k+1}=xk-Gk/LPhi; x_{k+1}=z_{k+1}+[(sqrt(kappa_x)-1)/(sqrt(kappa_x)+1)](z_{k+1}-zk).
variants.requirements: g(x,.) mu_y-strongly convex, grad_y Lipschitz Ly; Phi mu_x-strongly convex; valid public smoothness bound LPhi for outer iterates; derivatives needed for implicit gradient exist.; Exact partial f gradients, g_y gradients, g_yy HVP, g_xy product; no inverse-Hessian oracle.
variants.state_and_initialization: z0=x0=0; each outer step cold-start y^0=s^0=0. Set kappa_y=Ly/mu_y,kappa_x=LPhi/mu_x.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: lambda=4/(sqrt(Ly)+sqrt(mu_y))²; theta=max{(1-sqrt(lambda mu_y))²,(1-sqrt(lambda Ly))²}; positive supplied N,M; source complexity-specific N,M are not expanded here.
